content.short: Mellow Protocol enables active liquidity management and automatic DeFi strategies.
content.description: Mellow Protocol is a platform for building automatic trustless DeFi strategies. The system is permissionless and acts as an integration and execution layer for DeFi. It is audited by Chainsecurity and BlockSec. The platform offers four major families of strategies: Boosted (generates additional yield on UniV3 positions by deploying capital to Yearn or AAVE V3); Pulse (protocol liquidity management on DEXes with LM rewards compounding); Fearless Gearbox (leveraged farming on Convex with liquidation protection); and Voltz LP optimizer (Voltz tooling to simplify LPing for users of the protocol). The platform provides professional tooling for native protocol liquidity management on DEXes with customization and dashboards. Current integrations include Uniswap V3, Quickswap, Kyber, AAVE V2/V3, Gearbox, Curve, Convex, Voltz, and Cowswap.
